files.description: Registered EHI export documentation PDF — actually contains the Amazing Charts EHI Export data dictionary (44 data classes, ~1094 columns, CSV/JSON/XML format). 8 pages. Despite Picasso filename, document title says 'Amazing Charts EHI Export.'

Picasso-specific EHI export data dictionary found on mandatory disclosures page. 21 data classes, ~441 columns, CSV-only format. 3 pages. Uses Picasso-specific ALL_CAPS column naming. Created Jan 2024.
Picasso Application Access API documentation. 4 pages. SOAP-style web service returning USCDI-compliant CCD XML. This is a (g)(10)-style API, not the (b)(10) EHI export. Included for completeness.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that extracts structured data class definitions from both EHI export PDFs into queryable JSON.
Structured JSON extraction of the Picasso-specific EHI export data dictionary: 21 data classes with column names and counts.
Structured JSON extraction of the Amazing Charts EHI export data dictionary: 44 data classes with column names and counts.
Enrichment accounting: files discovered (3), files parsed (2), parse failures (1 — API doc not structured).
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, known parsing limitations.
